title: 3D-MoE: Complementarity-Guided Hardware-Software Co-Design for MoE Decode on 3D-Stacked NMP
abstract: arXiv:2610.26991v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) have become a mainstream way to scale Large Language Models (LLMs), because each token activates only a small subset of experts, reducing inference cost. However, MoE decode remains highly memory-bound and exhibits strongly skewed, time-varying expert loads. 3D-stacked DRAM near-memory processing (NMP) provides the bandwidth that decode demands, yet its tiled organization makes load balancing expensive: expert parallelism (EP) preserves locality but suffers from hotspot-induced imbalance, while more distributed strategies weaken locality and increase NoC traffic.   To address this locality-balance conflict, we observe that domain-specialized token routing creates offsetting expert-load fluctuations across decode steps, a property we call expert complementarity. translated_title: 3D-MoE：面向3D堆叠近存处理上MoE解码的互补性引导软硬件协同设计
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型已成为扩展大语言模型的主流方式，因为每个token仅激活一小部分专家，从而降低了推理成本。然而，MoE解码仍然高度受内存限制，并表现出强烈偏斜且随时间变化的专家负载。3D堆叠DRAM近存处理（NMP）能够提供解码所需的带宽，但其分片式的组织结构使得负载均衡代价高昂：专家并行（EP）保持了局部性，但易受热点引起的不均衡影响；而更加分布式的策略则会削弱局部性并增加片上网络流量。为了解决这种局部性与负载均衡之间的冲突，我们观察到领域专业化的token路由会在各解码步骤之间产生相互抵消的专家负载波动，我们将这一特性称为专家互补性。基于这一洞察，我们提出了3D-MoE，一个面向3D堆叠NMP上MoE解码的软硬件协同设计系统。3D-MoE利用离线的一次性互补性……
tldr: 提出3D-MoE系统，通过“专家互补性”这一关键洞察（即领域专业化路由使跨解码步骤的专家负载波动相互抵消），以软硬件协同设计化解3D堆叠近存处理上MoE解码中局部性与负载均衡的冲突。
en_tdlr: 3D-MoE exploits the insight of expert complementarity—where domain-specialized token routing creates offsetting expert-load fluctuations across decode steps—through hardware-software co-design to resolve the locality-balance conflict in MoE decode on 3D-stacked near-memory processing.
